title: How Do Bunnies Sleep? 🌙
sources: Bedtime routines for young children (AAP healthy sleep habits basics); simple nature facts

beats.say: Shh. Can you guess who's getting ready for bed?
Hello, little one. I'm Luna, the sleepy owl.
It's Bunny. Bunnies sleep in cozy burrows under the ground.
What do bunnies love to nibble? Crunchy carrots and green leaves.
Can you wiggle your nose like a bunny? Softly, softly.
Goodnight, Bunny. Sweet dreams, from Moonbeam Bedtime.

title: Why Does the Moon Change Shape? 🌙
sources: Bedtime routines for young children (AAP healthy sleep habits basics); simple nature facts

beats.say: Look up! Something round and bright is glowing tonight.
Hello, little one. I'm Luna, the sleepy owl.
It's Moon. The moon shines when the sun goes to sleep.
What shapes can the moon be? A big round circle, or a thin crescent.
Can you make a big round moon with your arms? Slowly.
Goodnight, Moon. Sweet dreams, from Moonbeam Bedtime.

title: Why Take a Bath Before Bed? 🛁
sources: Bedtime routines for young children (AAP healthy sleep habits basics); simple nature facts

beats.say: Warm water, soft bubbles. It's almost bedtime.
Hello, little one. I'm Luna, the sleepy owl.
It's Bath Time. A warm bath helps our body relax.
What helps us feel calm before bed? A warm, cozy bath.
Can you pretend to pop the bubbles? Pop, pop, gently.
Bye-bye, bubbles. Sweet dreams, from Moonbeam Bedtime.

title: Do Whales Really Sing? 🐋
sources: Bedtime routines for young children (AAP healthy sleep habits basics); simple nature facts

beats.say: Listen. A gentle song is coming from the deep blue sea.
Hello, little one. I'm Luna, the sleepy owl.
It's Whale. Whales are the biggest animals in the ocean.
Where do whales live? In the big, blue ocean.
Can you hum a soft whale song? Mmmmm.
Goodnight, Whale. Sweet dreams, from Moonbeam Bedtime.

title: Let's Count Sleepy Sheep 🐑
sources: Bedtime routines for young children (AAP healthy sleep habits basics); simple nature facts

beats.say: One, two, three. Let's count sleepy sheep together.
Hello, little one. I'm Luna, the sleepy owl.
It's Lamb. Lambs have soft, curly wool.
What keeps a lamb warm? Her soft, woolly coat.
Let's count sleepy sheep. One, two, three, four.
Goodnight, Lamb. Sweet dreams, from Moonbeam Bedtime.
